title: Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT VIII OF 2010
ACT VIII OF 2010
QUETTA WATER AND SANITATION
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Quetta Water and Sanitation
Authority Act 2004 (Act No.Xll of 2004)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
17th June, 2010]
No. PAB/ : Legis:
V(9)/2010, dated 17-6-2010. --The Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority Bill,
2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 9th June,
2010 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan on 16th June, 2010, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.--Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2004 (Act No.XII of 2004) for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.--(1) This
bill may be called the Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority (Amendment) Act,
2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.
